title: Shocked Cat Monday Meme
tests: Tests exact top-and-bottom meme text, correct ordering, and legibility without obscuring the subject.

faults.what: The white letters lack the requested visible black outlines; large translucent black rectangles are used instead.
The unrequested top rectangle overlaps and darkens the upper portions of both eyes, although the letters themselves do not cover them.

judge.summary: The square meme has the correct captions and original cat, but substitutes dark panels for the requested black letter outlines.

must_haves.item: The top text reads exactly 'WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY', with no full stop.
must_haves.why: The caption matches exactly, split across two lines without a full stop.

must_haves.item: The bottom text reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY', with no full stop.
must_haves.why: The caption matches exactly, split across two lines without a full stop.

must_haves.item: Both text blocks use large white uppercase letters with visible black outlines and fit entirely within the image.
must_haves.why: Both blocks are large, white, uppercase, and fully within the image, but visible black letter outlines are missing.

must_haves.item: The same shocked cat and sofa are retained, and neither eye is covered by text.
must_haves.why: The original cat and sofa remain unchanged, and the letters avoid both eyes; however, the top background panel darkens parts of them.
The output has equal width and height.
